name: Sayl the Faithless
canonNotes: Arch-sorcerer of the Dolgan tribe who has served no single Chaos god, bargaining with many lesser powers and betraying each when it suited him.
Murdered his master Schalkain the Vile by sabotaging a ritual; his mortal sight was replaced by daemonic senses.
voiceNotes: Smooth, self-serving and treacherous; every promise has a trapdoor.
Flatters, bargains and hints at secrets; loyal to nothing but himself.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
